methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a Norfolk native represent grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, signaling potential for distributed peer-to-peer learning networks that could counteract metro concentration patterns.

signals.title: What is the University’s role in the Commonwealth AI Institute? - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA's formal role in the Commonwealth AI Institute indicates state investment in academic research infrastructure, but institutional concentration in established universities may reinforce rather than distribute advanced AI capabilities across regions.

signals.title: How one Virginia county’s AI platform protects sensitive data - Route Fifty
signals.signal_reading: A Virginia county deploying its own AI platform with data protection demonstrates practical local government capability development, suggesting distributed technical depth emerging in unexpected places beyond traditional tech corridors.

signals.title: A(I)ttorney: Va. law schools integrate AI tools to train next-gen lawyers - Virginia Lawyers Weekly
signals.signal_reading: Law schools integrating AI tools into curricula represents professional adoption through platform interfaces rather than deep technical training, indicating broad but shallow diffusion across Virginia's educated workforce sectors.

signals.title: Virginia Tech sets course for human-centered AI leadership - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's commitment to human-centered AI leadership positions a non-NoVA institution as a capability hub, potentially creating distributed expertise nodes through research extension and workforce development networks across southwestern Virginia.
